meta.name: animate
meta.description: Review a feature and enhance it with purposeful animations, micro-interactions, and motion effects that improve usability and delight.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为功能添加有目的性的动画和微交互，提升可用性与愉悦感
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望为产品界面增加细腻的动效和交互反馈
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to enhance your product interface with refined motion and interactive feedback

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你提供的功能或组件，为其添加有目的的动画和微交互，以提升可用性和愉悦感。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为一个功能或组件添加动画时触发。它会先收集上下文（如目标受众、品牌调性），必要时会向你提问。

say.text: 帮我给这个登录按钮添加点击反馈动画。
say.note: Claude 会分析按钮并添加微交互。

say.text: 为这个页面加载过程设计一个入场动画序列。
say.note: Claude 会规划并实现入场动画。

say.text: 检查这个表单的交互，添加合适的动画。
say.note: Claude 会评估并添加反馈动画。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze the feature or component you provide and add purposeful animations and micro-interactions to improve usability and delight.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add animations to a feature or component. It will first gather context (e.g., target audience, brand tone) and may ask you questions if needed.

say_en.text: Add click feedback animation to this login button.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the button and add micro-interaction.

say_en.text: Design an entrance animation sequence for this page load.
say_en.note: Claude will plan and implement entrance animations.

say_en.text: Review this form's interactions and add appropriate animations.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate and add feedback animations.
